'''Dark Lure''' is a spell within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 50 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast.

Casting Dark Lure causes the targeted monster to be lured towards the player, and will also stop monsters from [[retreat]]ing during combat, such as [[unicorn]]s and [[ghoul]]s. Monsters will still retreat while under the effects of Dark Lure if they are attacked from outside of their [[wander radius]]. Note that the spell only lures monsters close enough to attack the caster, not necessarily next to them. For example, [[Lizardman shaman|lizardman shamans]] will not be lured into melee range of the player. Dark Lure remains active on monsters for 61.2 seconds, during which time the spell cannot be cast on them again. 

The spell can also be cast on [[impling]]s, causing them to move towards a 2x2 area near the player for six seconds. During this time other players cannot cast Dark Lure on the same impling. The spell also has a 10.2 second cooldown time after being cast, which can create an opening for other players competing for an impling if it is not caught initially.

The spell does not work on [[chompy bird]]s.

Dark Lure cannot be used from the deck of a [[boat]]. Attempting to do so will cause a message to appear in the chatbox: {{mes|I can't do that from here!}}

Like combat spells, Dark Lure performs an accuracy roll and can splash, making it less useful on monsters with high Magic defence.
